cues: Every body paragraph is built with the same four moves.
Point: the topic sentence, one idea stated flatly.
Evidence: an example, a fact, a case.
Explain: why the evidence proves the point.
Link: a bridge to the next paragraph.
Most candidates write the first two and stop.
The third is where the content marks are, and the fourth is where the organisation marks are.
